usage.useWhen: Content of another provider that is no video and no map, given as the address of an iframe: a configurator, a booking tool, a form of a service. Add the provider under Settings, Privacy first, so the placeholder names it and links to its privacy policy.
usage.avoidWhen: Videos and posts of YouTube, Vimeo, X and similar sites; the embed block gets the same placeholder. Maps; use leitvia/map. Pages of the own site.
usage.a11y: Set the title: it names the iframe for screen readers. After the visitor loads the content, the focus moves to the iframe and a status message announces it. Without JavaScript the placeholder links to the content.
